text:
alex: PM for 2026-03-20 inference slowdown posted. We need to convert remediation items into concrete tests and handoffs: regression, burst load, expanded prompt-set, and a focused chaos drill. Quick owner + ETA replies please.
jamie: I'll take the regression harness for the prefix/KV-cache race. Plan: unit + small integration that runs in staging CI. ETA 3 business days.
rina: I can build the burst/soak job. Suggest k6 with a GH Actions schedule + Grafana dashboard. Will include a param for 10k short requests and a steady-state soak. ETA 5 days.
tony: I'll own the chaos experiment. Tabletop first, then a staged run that kills a replica during a burst to validate routing & cache repop. Success criteria: fallback routing <30s, error spike limited, quality preserved. Proposed staging window: next Wed 11am PT.
ops-bot: PM-2026-03-20 linked: https://pm.redwood/company/PM-7890
alex: Please write timelines here and drop GH links. We want a staging canary run before next production deploy.
jamie: Regression plan: PR with tests + micro-eval that compares outputs pre/post fallback to catch model-swap regressions. PR target: Fri EOD (1862345678 + 4d). Will add README for running locally.
rina: Load job sketch to land in CI:
```
name: incident-burst-k6
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '30 02 * * 3'
jobs:
  run-burst:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./ci/run_k6.sh --script k6/burst_10k_short.js --vus 10000 --duration 60s
```
rina: Dashboard will track 95p latency, error-rate, and KV-eviction counts. Aim to have action + dashboard by next Tuesday.
tony: Chaos playbook (draft): cycle one replica every 20s during a 2m burst, verify fallback, measure cache warmup time, and ensure eval microchecks pass. I'll draft and post in #eng-oncall and run tabletop Monday.
alex: Where will prompt sets live? We should keep them under evals repo and reference in regression PRs.
jamie: I'll pair with whoever owns prompt cases for micro-eval thresholds.
rina: I'll file an ops ticket to hand off dashboard/alert ownership to eng-sre and include suggested PromQL for KV-eviction.
ops-bot: Created ticket OPS-9123 for recurring KV-eviction detection.
alex: Owners & rough deadlines recap: regression (jamie) by +4d; burst job (rina) by +5d; prompt-set + evals (TBD) by +7d; chaos drill (tony) next Wed staging. Please link PRs here when created.
jamie: Opening GH issue now and will add labels: incident-test, priority-high, owner-jamie.
tony: I'll schedule tabletop and the staged run; will post playbook and checklist in the repo.
rina: Once dashboard is wired, I'll add an alert routed to #incidents and an automated weekly report.
alex: Weekly follow-up Friday 9am PT to review staging canary results. If anything slips, update this thread with blockers. :thumbsup:
